title: 03. Just One Little Hello
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Every morning, greetings filled the Rainbow Class. Hi! Good morning! Toto and Kongi waved high in the air. Bori wanted to say hello, too. In Bori's mind, the words had already been said a hundred times.
Bori opened their mouth to say, Hello! But the voice seemed to hide away. With rosy cheeks, Bori clutched the backpack straps. Why is one little hello so hard to say?
Without a hello, Bori couldn't ask to play, either. Alone in a corner, Bori fiddled with blocks. Even when the other friends laughed, it felt too hard to go over.
The friends soon grew close and laughed together. Bori watched quietly. I want to join them, too. Bori's heart wanted to run over, but the feet wouldn't move.
Bori gathered some courage and took a step toward the friends. H, h, hello. But the voice hid away again. Bori quickly turned back. Only a pounding heartbeat could be heard.
Bori felt sad. Why can't I even say hello? Hugging both knees, Bori bowed their head low. Tears were almost ready to fall.
Gentle Teacher Sheep sat down beside Bori. If the words won't come out, shall we wave first? Like this. Hello! Teacher Sheep waved softly, and Bori tried a little wave, too.
Just then, Hori ran up to Bori. Hi, Bori! Want to play with me? Hori held out his hand first. Seeing that warm hand made Bori feel warm inside, too.
Bori took a deep breath and held Hori's hand. Then, very quietly but clearly, came the word, Hello. The first hello spoken out loud! A bright smile bloomed on Bori's face.

The next morning, Bori opened the classroom door and waved high in the air. Hello, everyone! The first time was hard, but the second was much easier. One little greeting had opened the door to friendship.
